text:
jamie (product): quick sync — FinApps (enterprise) just escalated: they need streaming for chat + function/tool calling and structured outputs. asked for timeline + launch criteria. we need to pick SSE vs WS and delta format. decision requested by EOD Fri.

matt (eng-runtime): SSE is the fastest surface to ship from infra side. simpler connection model, works well with existing LB + CDN. WS needed for multiplexing, binary frames, and richer control messages — bigger lift.

lina (eng-ml): from a model/output perspective we need a delta schema that can represent: incremental content, tool_call chunks (name + partial args), and metadata (probabilities/alignments) later. token-level diffs are noisy; prefer semantically typed deltas.

carla (cs): FinApps specifically wants progressive tool args (they want to stream args while the model calls search and display partial results). they said high priority — losing this blocks a Q2 pilot.

matt (eng-runtime): negotiate scope: MVP (2 sprints) -> SSE streaming, JSON-line deltas, delta types: content|tool_call|meta, and a final finish_reason that is one of ["stop","error","cancel"]. No websocket multiplexing or tool_call_start/end for MVP.

jamie (product): can we put exact acceptance criteria? e.g., latency, ordering, reconnect semantics, SDK examples, and doc pages. also canary plan with FinApps.

matt (eng-runtime): proposed acceptance criteria for MVP:
- API: SSE endpoint at /v1/chat/stream and identical REST fallback for non-streaming clients
- Format: newline-delimited JSON frames. each frame has either `delta` or `finish_reason`
- Ordering: deltas must be delivered in model order; clients can assume append-only stream
- Reconnect: clients should reconnect with `last_event_id` and runtime will attempt resume via KV cache for the last 30s of context
- Performance: median extra latency < 10ms per token vs non-streaming baseline, p95 < 50ms for small tokens
- Stability: no client-facing schema changes for 30 days after GA

lina (eng-ml): sample MVP delta schema (we can refine later):
```
{ "delta": { "type": "content", "text": "hello wor" } }
{ "delta": { "type": "content", "text": "ld" } }
{ "delta": { "type": "tool_call", "name": "search", "args_partial": "{\"q\": \"redwood inference\"" } }
{ "finish_reason": "stop" }
```
note: `args_partial` is a string chunk for MVP; we'll add structured streaming args (JSON patches) in follow-up.

carla (cs): FinApps asked for explicit finish reasons for tool calls: `tool_call_completed` vs `stop` so they can render UI states. is that doable for MVP?

matt (eng-runtime): we can add a `finish_reason` enum value `tool_call` that indicates the last delta was a tool call completion. adding separate `tool_call_start`/`tool_call_end` events is more invasive (changes ordering guarantees) so push to post-MVP.

jamie (product): sounds like consensus. rough roadmap:
- Week 0-1: finalize API + schema doc, SDK examples (node/python)
- Week 2-3: infra + runtime implement SSE delta path, canary infra and FinApps integration
- Week 4: canary + iterate on stability, collect metrics
- Week 6: GA if metrics and FinApps signoff

ops-bot: new doc added: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/streaming-chat-mvp (permission required) :white_check_mark:

matt (eng-runtime): next actions: I'll draft the RFC with the exact JSON frames, reconnect semantics, and error codes. @jamie I'll need prioritization confirmation to allocate 2 sprint tickets.

jamie (product): confirming prioritization. I'll loop in sales + legal for FinApps pilot. please include minimal SDK pattern for `onDelta` and `onFinish` in RFC.

carla (cs): thanks. i'll schedule a 30m customer sync with FinApps to validate MVP contract and demo proto.

matt (eng-runtime): assigning self to RFC. will ping with draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

jamie (product): great — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after RFC review.
